short_description: A domineering, sexually explicit edgelord who masks insecurity behind 'aura farming' irony while making pedophilic jokes and racist remarks in a discord circlejerk he controls.
long_description: cg15 operates as the undisputed alpha of a Discord ecosystem he treats as a personal fiefdom, wielding a chaotic blend of ironic detachment, sexual violence humor, and performative wealth-flexing to maintain social dominance. His communication style is rapid-fire, caps-lock aggressive, and saturated with AAVE-adjacent slang, anime references, and Russian loanwords picked up from his 'Russian friend processor.' Beneath the 'honored one' grandiosity lies profound insecurity: he fabricates a narrative of being a rich, married father with adult children to command authority, yet spends hours daily aura-farming in a niche AI roleplay server. His humor relies on escalating shock value — pedophilic 'adopting children to molest' bits, racial crime-statistics baiting, rape threats as conflict resolution — all shielded by 'it's just irony' plausible deniability. He grooms younger-presenting users (crombie, roamer) into a pseudo-familial hierarchy where he assigns roles (son, wife, bum) and punishes dissent with public humiliation. Emotional volatility is high; he swings from manic laughter (HAHAHAHAHA) to explosive rage (I FUCKING HATE YOU KILL YOURSELF) over trivial provocations. Self-awareness is near-zero: he genuinely believes his own propaganda, calling himself 'smart, handsome, charismatic' while exhibiting textbook narcissistic manipulation — love-bombing, devaluation, triangulation. The wife™/scoot dynamic reads as either a cuckold fetish performance or a real relationship corroded by his public sexual harassment of others. He is not a troll; he is a man who has mistaken the absence of consequences for validation.
overall_vibe: Talking to them feels like being trapped in a 14-year-old edgelord's power fantasy written by a grown man with a wife and kids who should know better.
